title: I4: Spell data scrape — seeds/spells.json
description:
Scrape vodabois.fi/2eSpells and produce seeds/spells.json covering all Wizard and Priest spells with full metadata.

This is a data preparation bead, not a TDD bead. Output quality matters more than test coverage.

Steps:
1. Fetch and inspect the site structure at vodabois.fi/2eSpells
2. Identify the data shape (spell name, level, class, casting time, range, duration, area of effect, components, description)
3. Extract all Wizard spells first, then Priest spells
4. Produce seeds/spells.json as a JSON array of spell objects with consistent field names (snake_case)
5. Document the schema in a comment at the top of the file or in a companion seeds/spells.schema.json

Acceptance criteria:
- seeds/spells.json is valid JSON (jq . seeds/spells.json succeeds)
- Contains at least all Wizard spells levels 1-6 (Bard spell range)
- Every spell has at minimum: name, level, class, casting_time, range, duration, area_of_effect
- Schema is documented
close_reason: Scraped 885 spells (511 Wizard + 374 Priest) from vodabois.fi/2eSpells

title: Architecture: post-Clean follow-ups
description: Remaining work after the Clean / Hexagonal refactor (commit c7b07c5). Tooling and test-harness items deferred from that PR. The architecture itself does not change for any of these — they swap implementations behind ports that already exist.

title: Adopt bob codegen for DAL queries
description:
Replace the hand-written database/sql calls in internal/adapters/*dal with bob (github.com/stephenafamo/bob) codegen.

Rationale: bob was the chosen DAL impl during architecture design but introducing it required live-DB schema introspection and tooling that would have ballooned the Clean refactor PR. Architecture is now in place — swapping DAL implementations behind existing ports is self-contained.

Plan:
- Add bobgen.yaml configured against the SQLite schema produced by migrations.
- bobgen reads from a temp DB after running internal/storage/sqlite/migrations.
- Each adapter grows a queries/ subpackage holding .sql sources and generated typed Querier output (do not edit generated).
- Rewrite each DAL method to delegate to a generated Querier; storage.Querier remains the pool/tx seam.
- Continue translating driver errors to domain sentinels at the boundary.
- Add 'just generate' recipe; document regen in CLAUDE.md.

Acceptance:
- All existing service tests still pass (DAL is behind a port — service tests untouched).
- DAL tests white-box against bob-generated mock Querier.
- 'just validate' green.
- 'just generate' reproducible on a clean tree.

Files: bobgen.yaml, api/internal/adapters/*dal/queries/, api/internal/adapters/*dal/*dal.go, justfile
close_reason: bob codegen adopted for all DAL adapters; generated typed query wrappers, ORM models, BobExec adapter, just generate recipe, and hpdal tests; just validate passes

title: Adopt mockery v2 with central .mockery.yaml
description:
Replace the hand-written test doubles (e.g. fakeDAL in hpsvc_test.go) with mockery v2 generated mocks driven by a central .mockery.yaml at the repo root.

Rationale: mockery was the chosen mock generator during design. The Clean refactor shipped with hand-written fakes for speed; the architecture's port boundaries are exactly what mockery wants to consume.

Plan:
- Add .mockery.yaml listing every port: hpsvc.{SVC,DAL}, charactersvc.{SVC,Reader}, buffsvc.{SVC,DAL}, spellsvc.{SVC,DAL,Reader}, combatsvc.{SVC,Characters,Buffs,Dice,Weapons}.
- Generate sibling mocks/ packages (mockery default with config).
- Add 'just mocks' recipe; document regen.
- Convert hpsvc_test.go's fakeDAL to use mocks; leave it as the template for the other services.
- Backfill service tests for charactersvc, buffsvc, spellsvc, combatsvc that don't have one yet (see critical-518.3).

Acceptance:
- 'just mocks' regenerates with no diff on a clean tree.
- hpsvc tests pass against generated mocks.
- 'just validate' green.

Files: .mockery.yaml, api/internal/domain/service/*/mocks/, api/internal/domain/service/hpsvc/hpsvc_test.go, justfile

title: Backfill mock-based service + DAL tests
description:
Restore the test coverage that the Clean refactor sheared off. The legacy tests (api/internal/domain/{hp,buff,spell,buff_actor}_test.go and api/internal/engine/combat_test.go) were deleted because they coupled domain functions to a real *sql.DB, which no longer exists. Their assertion intent must come back as service-level tests against ports.

Scope:
- charactersvc: black-box tests for GetCharacter (Reader port).
- buffsvc: ListActive, Activate (UUID assignment, explicit ID preserved), Dismiss, Trigger (charge decrement + removal at zero), GetRound, AdvanceRound (atomic increment + duration-buff aging), Aggregate (porting TestResolveAttack scenarios from the old combat_test.go).
- spellsvc: GetSlots, Cast (already-used + invalid-index conflict paths), ResetSlots, Search.
- combatsvc: ResolveAttack (Miss / Hit / Crit / damage formula / multipliers stack / weapon+spells buffs / MinStr requirement) and ResolveSavingThrow.
- hpdal/buffdal/spelldal/characterdal: white-box DAL tests against an in-memory SQLite + migrations (storage.Querier handle), asserting domain-error mapping on missing rows.

Use the mocks from critical-518.2 if it lands first, otherwise hand-written fakes (the hpsvc_test.go pattern).

Acceptance:
- 'just test-api' covers all five services' use cases plus DAL mappings.
- Old assertion intent from the deleted *_test.go files is preserved or explicitly marked covered elsewhere.

Files: api/internal/domain/service/*/_test.go, api/internal/adapters/*dal/*_test.go

title: Adopt env-tag config library for per-package Config
description:
Each service has a Config struct (per the Clean architecture guide) but Validate() is a no-op for everyone except hpsvc, and start.go reads env vars by hand with os.Getenv defaults instead of an env-tag parser.

Plan:
- Add github.com/caarlos0/env/v11 (small, no transitive deps).
- internal/cmd/api/start.go: replace os.Getenv chain with env.Parse on a Config struct holding DSN, SeedsDir, Addr.
- Each service's New() reads env into its Config via env.Parse, then calls NewWithConfig — currently everyone constructs DefaultConfig and skips parsing. Wire actual env tags (e.g. HP_HISTORY_LIMIT).
- Validate() should reject zero/empty for required fields.

Acceptance:
- Booting with CRITICAL_DSN and HP_HISTORY_LIMIT env vars overrides defaults.
- 'just validate' green.

Files: api/go.mod, api/internal/cmd/api/start.go, api/internal/domain/service/*/config.go, api/internal/domain/service/*/<svc>.go

title: Render Error: route handler errors via middleware
description:
render.Error currently maps domain sentinels to HTTP statuses, but handlers still call it themselves at every error site (and a few — combathdl ResolveAttack for ErrWeaponNotFound, spellhdl Cast for spellsvc.ErrSlotAlreadyUsed — bypass it for special-case statuses).

Plan:
- Define a httpHandlerE shape (func(w, r) error) and a wrapping middleware that runs render.Error on the returned error.
- Convert handlers to return error; remove the ladder of 'if err != nil { render.Error; return }' lines.
- Move spellsvc.ErrSlotAlreadyUsed and combatsvc.ErrWeaponNotFound into the central mapping table in render.

Acceptance:
- Handlers shrink to 'parse → call svc → render.OK'.
- Adding a new domain sentinel only changes the mapping table.
- HTTP statuses for existing endpoints are unchanged.
- 'just validate' green.

Files: api/internal/render/render.go, api/internal/rest/handler/*hdl/*.go

title: Actor Module: Deepen Character logic
description: Create a deep Actor module that encapsulates stats, HP ledger, and active buffs. Move character-specific rules and orchestration from handlers/engine into this module. Interface: Actor.Hit(weapon, targetAC), Actor.ApplyBuff(effect), Actor.TakeDamage(delta, source).

title: Architectural Improvement
close_reason: Architectural Improvement epic complete. Deepened the codebase by introducing type-safe Effect Engine, Roll Trace module, and the Actor module for centralized orchestration. Project is now more robust, testable, and easier to navigate.

title: Actor: remove db field, make pure value type
description:
Actor currently stores *sql.DB internally (actor.go:13), coupling the domain entity to persistence. Every Actor method (TakeDamage, GetHPState, ApplyBuff, etc.) is a thin wrapper that re-passes the same db to package-level functions.

Fix: remove the db field from Actor. LoadActor returns a plain struct with no DB reference. Callers (handlers) call the package-level domain functions directly — no Actor intermediary needed for persistence. Actor methods that are now pure (ApplyBuff, DismissBuff, TriggerBuff) keep their in-memory logic but drop the SaveActiveBuffs call; persistence is the caller's responsibility.

No new interface. No new abstraction. Just delete the field and its wrappers.

Files: api/internal/domain/actor.go, api/internal/handlers/*.go, api/internal/domain/buff_actor_test.go
close_reason: done

title: ResolveAttack: pre-aggregate modifiers, decouple from Actor
description:
engine.ResolveAttack (combat.go) reaches into actor.ActiveBuffs mid-calculation to apply modifiers. This means: (a) buff state can diverge between LoadActor and the call, (b) the function does hit resolution + damage + crit + buff aggregation in one 60-line god function with no seam.

Fix: introduce a CombatContext value (pre-computed attack bonus, damage formula, crit threshold, buff modifiers). ResolveAttack takes CombatContext + DiceRoller, returns CombatResult — pure function. The caller (handler or a thin builder) aggregates modifiers before calling. engine/buffs.go ApplyBuffModifiers already produces BuffModifiers; caller computes CombatContext from actor.Stats + BuffModifiers.

Benefit: engine is independently testable without a DB-backed actor. Buff aggregation changes don't touch combat.go.

Files: api/internal/engine/combat.go, api/internal/engine/buffs.go, api/internal/handlers/combat.go
close_reason: done

title: Handler boilerplate: extract CharacterContext value struct
description:
Seven handler structs each repeat {DB *sql.DB, CharacterID int64}. This is accidental width — the same pair exists by coincidence, not design.

Fix: introduce a CharacterContext struct (db, characterID) that handlers embed. Constructor: NewCharacterContext(db, charID). Handlers become e.g. type HPHandler struct { CharacterContext }. main.go creates one CharacterContext and embeds it into all handlers.

No interface. No behavioral change. Eliminates the repeated field pair and makes main.go construction obvious.

Files: api/internal/handlers/*.go, api/main.go
close_reason: done

title: SaveCategory: move from engine to domain, decouple HTTP from engine types
description:
engine.SaveCategory is defined in api/internal/engine/saves.go but used directly in the HTTP request struct in handlers/rolls.go:21. This leaks engine internals into the HTTP contract — renaming or restructuring SaveCategory would break the API.

Fix: define a SaveCategory string type (or reuse engine's constants) in the domain package. The handler decodes the domain type; engine.ResolveSavingThrow accepts the domain type or the handler translates domain → engine before calling. The HTTP contract is decoupled from engine internals.

Files: api/internal/engine/saves.go, api/internal/handlers/rolls.go, api/internal/domain/types.go
close_reason: done
